data.title: 堀京子 · 把晴天夹上晾衣绳
data.description: 晨光里的阳台上，京子穿薄荷条纹衫和深蓝背带裤，抱着衣篮夹好最后一条毛巾。风突然把毛巾翻过来，她歪头看着自己的劳动成果，笑着重新按住一角。
data.action: 夹住被风翻起的毛巾角，歪头轻笑。
data.promptProse: Kyouko Hori holds the laundry basket against her indigo dungarees while clipping the last towel on the morning balcony. A gust flips its corner; she tilts her head with a smile and presses the fabric flat, her mint-and-white striped sleeves clear in medium view. The basket occupies the near side, the balcony wall meets the railing behind her, and a neighboring building facade is visible across the gap beyond the rail. Soft morning daylight passes through the lifted towel edge to reveal its weave. Curved fabric shadows fall over the basket, while the inner wall and the underside of the railing stay gently shaded.
